# Middle School Lab Safety Scenario Cards

Subject: Science
Grade band: 6-8
Resource type: Scenario Cards
NYS framework label: New York State P-12 Science Learning Standards

## Short Description
Discussion cards that help students apply lab safety expectations to realistic classroom situations.

## Alignment Note
Supports safe science practices, collaboration norms, and investigation readiness.

## Classroom Use Case
Use before the first lab or as a reteach when safety procedures need tightening.

## Preview Content
- A partner starts mixing materials before directions.
- A beaker chips during cleanup.
- What should the group do first?

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
